agent_prompt:
CONTEXT:
- Project: NorthGuard — LLM prompt governance gateway (audit-grade evidence ledger).
- Tech: TypeScript, Node 20 ESM, strict; Vitest. See DECISION-REGISTER.md and AGENT-RULES.md.
- Current state: fresh core package; this is the first ledger story. Nothing depends on it yet, but everything will.

TASK:
Implement US-013: the append-only, hash-chained JSONL ledger writer (AF-401).

CREATE THESE FILES (see manifest.create): core/lib/types.ts (LedgerEntry + the contract types from specs/EP-01-gateway-adapter/EPIC.md), then SF-4011..4014 under core/src/features/ledger/append/, each with an adjacent .test.ts, plus index.ts.

FUNCTION SIGNATURES: exactly as in specs/EP-04-audit-ledger/APP-FUNCTIONS.md (AF-401 section) — loadChainTail, computeEntryHash, appendAtomic, appendLedgerEntry.

CHAIN ORDER: computeEntryHash → loadChainTail → appendAtomic → appendLedgerEntry.

RULES:
1. TDD: write the test first, watch it fail, then implement.
2. ONLY create files in this manifest. Do not touch protected paths.
3. TS strict — no any, no non-null assertions without proof.
4. NG-5: append must be atomic and survive process restart with no gap; a torn final line (crash mid-write) is ignored, not chained onto.
5. computeEntryHash MUST be canonical (key order independent) so verifyChain (AF-406, later) can recompute it.
6. No network, no external services — this is a local file.
7. After each function+test pair, run vitest on that file and report.
8. When done, run all ledger tests and report a summary. Write two entries and assert entry2.prevHash === entry1.hash.
